bungee-color.GPOS: no catalogued scene shapes text with this family: the colour sheet resolves code points through cmap and paints the COLR graph, never consulting pair positioning
bungee-color.GSUB: no catalogued scene shapes text with this family: the colour sheet never selects a substitution, so its locl and stylistic-set lookups carry no expectation

cff2-variable.*: synthetic variable CFF 2 fixture of the CFF journey and the scaler's variation tests; the CFF 2 outline expectation is pinned on cff2-liberation, and no catalogued scene references this family

dejavu.*: real DejaVu Sans, the default wide-coverage face of the layout module's paragraph fixtures; no catalogued scene references this family

emoji-two-colr-v0.GSUB: no catalogued scene shapes text with this family: the emoji sheets resolve code points through cmap and paint the COLR graph, never applying ccmp

gdef-kern.*: minimal GDEF/GPOS caret fixture of the layout and shaping suites; no catalogued scene references this family

kalligraphie-var-colr.glyf: the colour axis pins this fixture as rejected at face resolution, the CPU compositor refusing GlyphClip, so no catalogued scene ever decodes its outlines
kalligraphie-var-colr.loca: the colour axis pins this fixture as rejected at face resolution, the CPU compositor refusing GlyphClip, so no catalogued scene ever decodes its outlines

kalligraphie-var-vvar.VVAR: carried by the fixture; the catalogued scene rasterises the outline and observes no vertical metric, which the shaping suite covers
kalligraphie-var-vvar.fvar: carried by the fixture; the catalogued scene instantiates the default location, so it applies no axis value and reads no axis declaration
kalligraphie-var-vvar.vhea: carried by the fixture; the catalogued scene rasterises the outline and observes no vertical metric, which the shaping suite covers
kalligraphie-var-vvar.vmtx: carried by the fixture; the catalogued scene rasterises the outline and observes no vertical metric, which the shaping suite covers

liberation.kern: legacy pair-kerning records, every one of the 908 reproduced by the GPOS kerning the composed lines apply; no catalogued scene reads the redundant table

liberation-amiri-collection.*: Liberation + Amiri TrueType collection, the multi-face container fixture of the platform registry suites; no catalogued scene references this family

noto-sans-jp.BASE: the mosaic draws one glyph per weight on a single baseline and reads no baseline axis; the shaping suite covers the fixture's vertical layout
noto-sans-jp.HVAR: the mosaic draws one glyph per weight, so no advance is observable; the fixture's advance variation stays carried and unread here, and the shaping suite covers it
noto-sans-jp.STAT: the mosaic selects its instances by design `wght` coordinate through `fvar`/`avar` and reads no style attribute; `variation.stat` records that portable STAT reading is not implemented yet
noto-sans-jp.gasp: the mosaic rasterises the varied outlines with the portable CPU rasterizer, which applies no grid-fitting hint profile, so the table's flags and ranges are carried and never consulted
noto-sans-jp.vhea: carried by the fixture; the catalogued scene rasterises the outline and observes no vertical metric, which the shaping suite covers
noto-sans-jp.vmtx: carried by the fixture; the catalogued scene rasterises the outline and observes no vertical metric, which the shaping suite covers

skia-colr-v1.*: static COLR v1 fixture with transforms and gradients, read by the colour representation tests; the color axis pins COLR v1 on the synthetic variable fixture, and no catalogued scene uses the Skia file

skia-sbix.glyf: the catalogue's sbix scene draws the strike and resolves advances through hhea/hmtx; the sbix route does not require glyf, so this family's outlines are carried but never read
skia-sbix.loca: the catalogue's sbix scene draws the strike and resolves advances through hhea/hmtx; the sbix route does not require glyf, so this family's outlines are carried but never read

twemoji-svginot-glyph5.*: SVG-in-OpenType subset read by the glyph-representation suite; no catalogued scene renders an SVG glyph, so the family stays outside the claimed perimeter

worksans.STAT: the ladder selects its instances by design `wght` coordinate through `fvar` and `avar` and reads no style attribute; `variation.stat` records that portable STAT reading is not implemented yet
worksans.gasp: the ladder rasterises the varied outlines with the portable CPU rasterizer, which applies no grid-fitting hint profile, so the table's flags and ranges are carried and never consulted
